recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, centered headshot of a male subject with a direct gaze, set against a soft, airbrushed pastel gradient background. The lighting is diffused and even, minimizing harsh shadows, while the typography is placed in the upper corners to frame the head.
coreVisualRelationships: Symmetry between the subject's head and the square frame
Contrast between the dark, textured jacket and the light, ethereal background
Balance between the left-aligned name and right-aligned title
Harmonious color transition from the red undershirt to the blue-toned text
coreInvariants: Direct eye contact with the viewer
Soft-focus skin texture with preserved facial features
Pastel pink and blue gradient background
High-collar dark outerwear framing the neck

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered and fills approximately 70% of the vertical frame, cropped at the mid-chest.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes, positioned on the upper horizontal third line.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes lead to the top-left text, then across to the top-right text, finally resting on the subject's expression.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space, primarily in the upper corners around the typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted flesh tones and dark charcoal/black for the jacket.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Soft pastel pink and lavender in the background gradient.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep blue for the typography and a warm terracotta red for the undershirt.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation in the background creates a dreamlike quality, contrasting with the high-value dark jacket.

typesetting.case: All Caps for name; Title Case for title

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used with case variation to distinguish name from title.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the delicate stroke and 80s editorial feel.
Provides the necessary classical structure and availability.
Offers the traditional serif elegance seen in the original.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a close-up portrait of a man with 1980s styled hair, wearing a dark leather jacket with a fur collar and a red undershirt. The background should be a soft, airbrushed gradient of pastel pink, lavender, and light blue. Use a soft-focus lens effect.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add serif text in a deep blue color. Place the subject's name in all caps in the top-left corner and the title in title case, right-aligned, in the top-right corner.

verificationChecks: Is the background a soft pastel gradient?
Is the typography a thin, elegant serif?
Is the subject's gaze direct and centered?
Is the lighting diffused without harsh shadows?

mustRedesign: Specific facial identity of the artist
Exact wording of the original title
postGenerationChecks: Check for even skin tones and soft focus.
Ensure text is legible against the light background.
Verify the square aspect ratio typical of vinyl covers.
Confirm the dark jacket provides a solid base for the composition.
recipe.reuseFormula: Soft-focus portrait + pastel airbrushed gradient + corner-aligned serif typography = 1980s adult contemporary aesthetic.
